Messages.Author: davey! hathorn
Messages.Body:
Undead Persistence [Jyhad]
Combat
Discipline: Fortitude
Optional Press and vampire will not go to torpor until combat ends, or
3 rounds of
combat pass with no Methuselahs playing cards. Only usable when the
vampire
should go to torpor.
(S) Prevent 2 damage.

Suppose my Rufina Soledad has 2 blood, and she is whacked with 1 ag
damage. To keep
herself out of torpor, she plays basic Undead Persistence.

So now she has been wounded, but cannot heal the wound since it is Ag,
and also
cannot go into torpor because of UP. Right?

At this point, she burns 1 blood to heal each point of regular damage
she takes,
unless she runs out of blood, in which case she just shrugs off the
damage, right?

And for each point of ag she takes, she burns 1 blood to prevent
destruction,
unless she can't, in which case she is burned, right?

All this stuff is pretty unclear, so please, LSJ, put it in the
clarifications
section. Thankyou!

-davey!

> So now she has been wounded, but cannot heal the wound since it is Ag,

She's been wounded *because* she can't heal agg damage, right.

> At this point, she burns 1 blood to heal each point of regular damage
> she takes,
> unless she runs out of blood, in which case she just shrugs off the
> damage, right?

Rght.

> And for each point of ag she takes, she burns 1 blood to prevent

> unless she can't, in which case she is burned, right?

Right.

have complained about the length of the lists, so I try to keep
them as short as I can.
